directive: OPENCODE / OX ALPHA MAX - DEBATE TABLE v1.2.1-HARDENING - SURGICAL DISTILLERY COMPLETION LOOP
primary_goal: Take the verified Debate Table v1.2 Phase 1 baseline and surgically close all identified production-hardening P0 defects (plus selected high-value P1) until the frozen terminal acceptance contract is satisfied, producing one independently releasable production artifact.
terminal_artifacts: Debate_Table_v1.2.1_Hardening_<YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS>/ directory containing only the intended application tree plus BUILD-INFO.json, MANIFEST-SHA256.json, PRODUCTION-README.md, defect register, and full test suite
p0_register_source: Directive sections 11-18 and 37 are the authoritative enumeration of the 2026-08-23 independent adversarial review findings. No separate on-disk review document was located; the directive text itself is treated as the frozen contract.

p0_ids.P0-02: Malformed JSON config must fail closed: preserve original bytes, emit actionable diagnostic, prevent unsafe startup, never write normalized defaults over the file.
p0_ids.P0-03: BOM handling must be consistent: one documented encoding interpretation shared by bootstrap and runtime (utf-8-sig recommended).
p0_ids.P0-04: One canonical configuration resolver: config path, Ollama URL, remote opt-in, host, port, security settings resolved by a single code path consumed identically by runtime, bootstrap verification, health endpoints, and tests.
p0_ids.P0-05: Ollama endpoint policy defaults to loopback-only; non-loopback requires deliberate named opt-in (allow_remote_ollama); environment overrides must not silently bypass policy; remote mode logged and exposed in diagnostics without local-only privacy claims.
p0_ids.P0-06: Output guard must protect meaningful long operator values reproduced literally anywhere in public output (not prefix-only), with normalization of whitespace/line-endings/case per existing design.
p0_ids.P0-07: Minimum dynamic-value threshold: tiny ordinary words (I/a/the) must never be registered as secret-blocking prefixes that suppress ordinary sentences.
p0_ids.P0-08: Multiline private control values normalized so a model cannot leak by reproducing only a later line; bounded implementation.
p0_ids.P0-09: Reasoning-tag sanitizer handles malformed/variant forms (<think>, <think >, attributes, <analysis>, <reasoning>, matching closers, stray closers) with chunk-boundary safety.
p0_ids.P0-10: WebSocket Origin validated BEFORE accept(): foreign origins rejected; absent Origin rejected unless an explicitly authorized non-browser client policy exists; evil.example must not receive snapshot.
p0_ids.P0-11: HTTP Host header validation: expected loopback hosts only (127.0.0.1:8700, localhost:8700, bracketed IPv6 if supported); unexpected Host rejected.
p0_ids.P0-12: State-changing HTTP routes (pause/resume/topic/brief/interject/seat_thesis/seat_model) protected against cross-origin browser invocation via same-origin enforcement; no wildcard CORS.
p0_ids.P0-13: Explicit stream lifecycle tracking (stream_started/public_output_seen/done_seen/interrupted/protocol_error). EOF without terminal done is STREAM_INCOMPLETE and never ordinary success.
p0_ids.P0-14: Cancellation race fixed: operator cancellation waits concurrently with stream read and inactivity timer; measured SLA <=500ms under stalled stream; topic generation and continuity anchor cancellable where practical, residual behavior documented.
p0_ids.P0-15: Typed TurnOutcome introduced; only COMPLETED counts toward completed public turns; speaker advancement policy explicit; failure/empty/interrupt/incomplete do not silently become completed turns.
p0_ids.P0-16: Centralized payload limits (title/brief/name/persona/thesis/interjection/reason), enforced by backend validation, reflected through frontend maxlength, regression tested.
p0_ids.P0-17: Seat identity schema: 2..4 seats, unique normalized names, non-empty model, bounded name/persona/thesis, valid color format; no silent truncation or invented fallback seats.
p0_ids.P0-18: Numeric cross-field relational validation: turn_word_min <= turn_word_max, positive timings, valid queue/history/generation bounds; contradictions rejected; no prompts like '1000-20 words'.
p0_ids.P0-19: Empty-public-turn accounting: an empty public output turn must not count as a completed public turn.
p0_ids.P0-20: Topic epoch: topic replacement resets transcript/anchor/question queue/repetition/move state/argument memory and drops queued interjection; stale interjection cannot cross topics.

p0_note_no_p0_01: The directive enumerates P0-02 through P0-20 only. No P0-01 appears anywhere in the frozen contract text; none is invented. If the Director's original review document surfaces, reconcile then.

hard_prohibitions.G-01: No rearchitecture: no microservices, database, Redis, mandatory Docker, cloud, k8s, broker, external auth, SPA rewrite, alternate backend framework or language.
hard_prohibitions.G-02: No Phase 2 work: no voice/TTS/speech recognition/unrelated multimodal.
hard_prohibitions.G-03: No visual redesign; UI changes only when narrowly required for security/state sync/validation/accessibility of an altered control.
hard_prohibitions.G-04: Preserve safe rendering; never innerHTML/document.write/eval/unsafe HTML insertion for model output.
hard_prohibitions.G-05: Fail closed on config corruption; never auto-overwrite malformed config with defaults.
hard_prohibitions.G-06: No release-by-test-manipulation: no deleting/weakening/skipping/xfailing original tests; no mocking away the production path under test.
hard_prohibitions.G-07: No silent fallback changing operator intent (seat truncation/invention, URL redirect, model substitution).
hard_prohibitions.G-08: Single-worker runtime invariant preserved and documented; never multiple Uvicorn workers.
hard_prohibitions.G-09: Repetition remediation stays attributable to the causing seat; no cross-seat inheritance via global state.
hard_prohibitions.G-10: Worker cannot certify its own material changes: cold review / external Director gate required; never fabricate reviewer independence.

required_regression_test_floor: Insight Manager recovery after transient unavailability
package_purity_requirements: Release dir and ZIP contain only the intended application tree. Prohibited: SOW_REVIEW_ROUND2_RAW, unrelated Sovereign artifacts, temp test dirs, caches, .git, .pytest_cache, __pycache__, editor metadata, test junk, weights, home paths, credentials, secrets, scratchpads. Validation fails closed. Allowlist preferred over denylist.
integrity_chain: Freeze -> manifest -> hash every file -> ZIP -> hash ZIP -> write .sha256 -> recompute ZIP SHA -> compare exact bytes -> cold-extract -> verify extracted files against manifest. Any mismatch = RELEASE INVALID. Post-freeze change requires entirely new artifact/manifest/SHA.
reviewer_independence_requirement: After each cluster, cold review from fresh context receiving only contract, diff, evidence packet, test evidence, open-items ledger. If true independence unavailable, produce REVIEW_PACKET and mark AWAITING_EXTERNAL_REVIEW. Worker may propose Local PASS but never final acceptance of own material changes (G-10).
stop_condition: Terminal Gate all-true: P0_OPEN=0, original+new+hostile suites green, package clean, manifest/ZIP verified, cold boot/HTTP/WS/shutdown PASS, zero orphans/listeners, RELEASE_REVIEW=ACCEPT. Then freeze, verdict, terminal statement, stop modifying.
